noConnectedReader.title: No paired reader connected
noConnectedReader.description: No paired Attractap is connected right now. Readers must be paired before they can be used here; an administrator pairs them on the Attractap Readers page under "Not paired". If a paired reader is switched off, switch it on and wait until it is online.

firmwareUpdateRequired.title: Firmware update required
firmwareUpdateRequired.description: The connected Attractap readers need firmware 2.0.0 or later to enroll and reset RFID cards. They are offered the update automatically.

noCardEnrollment.title: No suitable reader
noCardEnrollment.description: None of the connected Attractap readers can enroll or reset RFID cards.

notAllowed.title: No reader allowed
notAllowed.description: None of the connected Attractap readers is allowed to enroll or reset RFID cards. An administrator can allow readers under Settings → RFID card enrollment.
